scope.contracts: Initial query used the USAspending default action_date filter. It can include 2026 modifications to older awards, so its recipients are not a list of awards first signed in 2026.
scope.newsAndBlogs: One GDELT DOC article query over its rolling 90-day window, classified by URL path/domain and filtered by title/URL relevance signals; these are candidate classifications, not source validation.
scope.usage: Discovery leads only. A contract, article, or blog hit cannot establish LATAM engineering hiring without explicit company-level evidence.
